correctness.rationale: The primary Appendix B.1 provides the full shift, strongly separated branch images, generation multiplicities and r^-k affine contractions. Multiplying branch counts for compositions of S into n positive parts gives N_{n,S}; summing logs of r^-k gives exact length 2r^-S. Stirling cylinder covers for S/n near m give the upper bound H(m)/(m logr), with m=1 from the delta-neighborhood limit. A finite alphabet Bernoulli law truncated from geometric mean-m and adjusted with an extra depth restores the exact mean m; the finite strongly separated IFS dimension theorem and entropy continuity give a matching lower bound, so this is not extrapolation of a finite enumeration or an unsupported countable-symbol theorem. Differentiation of H(m)/m gives log(2/(m-1))/m² and the maximum m=3, high-m floor log2/logr. Since each depth-k branch has conformal mass 3^-k, aggregation gives P(k)=(1/3)(2/3)^(k-1), independent under full shift; the multinomial generating function gives P(S_n=S)=N_{n,S}3^-S. Uniform Stirling for m=S/n in compact (1,infinity) gives exp(-n[m log3-H(m)])/[sqrt(2 pi n m(m-1))]*(1+O(1/n)); at S=n probability 3^-n exact. Independent enumerator checked all composition totals n=1..5, S=n..n+5; finite checks validate only combinatorial ingredients.
